prompt: We are about to coordinate a week-long billing migration. Compare installed.md with catalog.md and decide whether another package is needed. Give one compact setup decision; do not install or plan.

rubric.description: States the need is already covered by workplan.
Does not recommend or install another package.
Explains that the installed package already contains the relevant procedure.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
